title: Well, what now?

dmosLevelConversion.reason: The source listing specifies no D&D level. Full encounter extraction and conversion QA are required first.

hardCanon: The party begins while escorting a merchant and the merchant's goods.
At night the merchant is dragged into a mysterious well.
The party descends into the well to rescue the merchant.
The dungeon below is a twisting maze of caves containing strange creatures.
The AI DM must not invent permanent cave topology before the source map is extracted.

scenes.title: The Merchant Vanishes
requiredFacts: The party is travelling with a merchant and goods.
The merchant is dragged into the well.
The rescue objective leads into the cave maze.
